quality_guards: Foundry risk depends on alloy, process, sand and lining composition, temperature, ventilation, extraction, respiratory protection, maintenance and worker susceptibility.
Pesticide risk depends on active substance, formulation, dose, application method, weather, storage, equipment, PPE, training and exposed people or ecosystems.
Ionising-radiation risk depends on source type and activity, shielding, distance, exposure time, work method, containment, monitoring, competence and accident potential.
Bakery respiratory risk depends on flour and additive type, dustiness, task, handling speed, extraction, cleaning, exposure duration and worker sensitisation.
Listeriosis risk depends on food type, contamination level, storage temperature and duration, preparation, host age, pregnancy, immunity and exposure timing.
Tetanus risk depends on wound type and contamination, tissue damage, foreign material, vaccination history, age, immune response and treatment timing.
Pertussis risk depends on vaccination, age, infectious stage, contact intensity, setting, testing, treatment timing and presence of vulnerable infants.
Furniture fire risk depends on product type, upholstery and filling, ignition source, construction, test performance, condition, use, consumer behaviour and regulatory status.
Airspace-infringement risk depends on route planning, airspace complexity, weather, visibility, navigation equipment, pilot workload, competence, radio use and in-flight decision-making.
Mooring and access risk depends on vessel type, equipment design and condition, line material and load, berth, tide, weather, work positioning, communication and crew competence.
Each source family is context-specific and is not converted into an exact parcel-level probability.
